definitions.explanation: A sweet crystalline substance obtained from sugarcane or sugar beets, used as a sweetener in food and drinks.

examples.japanese: コーヒーに{砂糖|さとう}を{入|い}れますか。
examples.english: Do you put sugar in your coffee?

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}をもう{少|すこ}しください。
examples.english: Please give me a little more sugar.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}には{砂糖|さとう}を{使|つか}いません。

notes: One of the basic cooking ingredients along with {塩|しお} (salt). In Japanese cuisine, sugar is often used in savory dishes like teriyaki. {砂糖|さとう} can also be a common Japanese surname.
